Part II: commonly used all-electron basis sets (spherical Gaussian).

This file was generated using spherical AOs! Actually, there is
very little difference to Cartesian tensors, so either set may be used.

the order of d orbitals is xx, yy, zz, xy, xz and yz.
Orbitals containing d,f,g-functions were obtained from
ISPHER=1. Such orbitals can be used with any ISPHER in FMO runs.
